description: This file defines a Swift class `GatewayDiscoveryModel` responsible for discovering and managing gateway devices in a network environment. It includes data structures for representing local identities and discovered gateways, network discovery logic via Bonjour and other fallback mechanisms, as well as service resolution using DNS-SD. The class manages asynchronous tasks for continuous network discovery, filters local gateways, and provides utility functions for parsing TXT records and hostname normalization.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class responsible for discovering network gateways, managing discovery state, and resolving services.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Struct representing a resolved gateway service, including TXT record data, host, and port.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Class handling DNS-SD service resolution, including address resolution via NetService.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates network discovery across specified domains, setting up Bonjour browsers.

methods.name: refreshWideAreaFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate wide-area gateway discovery fallback.

methods.name: refreshTailscaleServeFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate Tailscale Serve gateway discovery fallback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing discovery tasks and clears internal state.

methods.name: mapWideAreaBeacons
methods.description: Maps wide-area beacon data to internal gateway representations.

methods.name: mapTailscaleServeBeacons
methods.description: Maps Tailscale Serve beacon data to internal gateway representations.
